## About
LA Collision Centers is a body shop on Lankershim Blvd in North Hollywood. We hold factory certifications from BMW, Mercedes-Benz, GM, Cadillac, Ford, Lincoln, Sprinter, Mini Cooper, Kia, Hyundai, Nissan and Infiniti, plus I-CAR Gold Class, so your car is repaired the way the manufacturer intended.
Frame straightening, body work, paint and mechanical repairs all happen in-house, and we use OEM parts only, never aftermarket. We're sponsored by Keyes European and Century West BMW.
One reviewer says Leo explains everything clearly and never pressures you. Another says Ali takes care of everything from start to finish. We're open weekdays, so give us a call or stop by.

## Services
- Frame repair: Structural repairs on Celette frame benches to bring your vehicle back to factory specifications.
- Certified body work: Collision repairs on steel and aluminum bodies, following manufacturer repair guidelines.
- Paint refinishing: Color-matched paint work with manufacturer-approved materials, covered by our lifetime warranty.
- Mechanical repairs: Mechanical work done in-house, following OEM-approved procedures.

## FAQ
Q: Which manufacturers do you hold certifications from?
A: We hold certifications from BMW, Mini Cooper, Mercedes-Benz, GM, Cadillac, Corvette and Chevrolet, Ford and Lincoln, Sprinter, Kia and Hyundai, Nissan and Infiniti, along with I-CAR Gold Class.

Q: Do you use aftermarket parts?
A: No. We use OEM dealer parts only.

Q: Can I get a free estimate?
A: Yes. You can request a free estimate through our website or give us a call.
